The Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) shall be Comprehensive in nature and shall include all spare pa rts, consumables, labour, service charges, transportation, installation, reinstallation, software loading, and any other incidental expenses required for satisfactory functioning of the UPS system. 2. The AMC shall be valid for 03 (Three) years from the date of commencement of the contract. 3. The successful bidder shall carry out Quarterly Preventive Maintenance (QPM) during the contract perio d in addition to attending all breakdown and corrective maintenance calls. 4. Breakdown complaints shall be attended immediately on receipt of intimation. The UPS system shallbe r estored to operational condition within 48 hours from the time of reporting the fault, failing which suit able deductions/penalties may be imposed as per contract terms. 5. The AMC shall cover the entire UPS system, including performance testing of the battery bank. Replace ment of defective UPS hardware components shall be carried out free of cost during the AMC period. 6. Preventive maintenance shall include cleaning of the equipment using suitable cleaning materials, funct ional testing, tightening of electrical connections, checking operating parameters, firmware/software verifi cation (where applicable), and submission of maintenance reports. 7. The successful bidder shall maintain a Service History Card/Log Book for each UPS, recording preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, complaints attended, downtime, repairs carried out, spare parts re placed, and service engineer details. The log book shall be produced to the Buyer whenever demanded. 8. In case the equipment requires repair at the service provider's workshop or OEM service centre, the bid der shall arrange pickup, transportation, repair, and reinstallation at the Buyer's premises at no additional cost. 9. Only new and genuine OEM spare parts shall be used. Repaired, refurbished, or counterfeit components shall not be accepted. 10. The bidder shall deploy trained and technically qualified service engineers for maintenance of the UPS system. 11. All preventive maintenance reports and breakdown service reports shall be duly signed by the authoriz ed representative of the Buyer after completion of the service. 12. Payment shall be released only after satisfactory completion of the AMC services as certified by the Bu yer. 13. The Buyer reserves the right to inspect the maintenance records and verify the quality of services at a ny time during the contract period . 7. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 8. Service & Support

Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 9. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under.
